## Scope and exclusions

## Actors and trust boundaries

List anonymous visitors, authenticated users, operators, service accounts, third-party providers, and administrators as applicable. Draw the boundaries and identify where trust changes.

## Data protection

Record data classification, minimization, encryption in transit/at rest, retention, export, deletion, backups, and processor access. Mark unknown items explicitly.

## Abuse and resilience

Assess payload size, rate limits, spam, enumeration, replay, denial of service, account takeover, privilege escalation, and recovery if relevant.

## Verification plan

List negative tests, access-control tests, code review, scanning, and penetration testing needed. Attach results after execution.
